digest.component_or_area: bridge provider test harness (test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py and siblings)
propositions: test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails on dev hosts with ambient command-scope git-config injection (safe.bareRepository=explicit) but passes in CI due to git subprocesses inheriting os.environ without holdout
git()/bare_git() harness helpers in test_run_reconcile_bridge.py inherit os.environ wholesale, allowing injected GIT_CONFIG_* variables to reach subprocess calls and fail bare repository verification

21 test failures across three bridge test files (test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py, test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py, test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py) on hostile hosts are all caused by the same GIT_CONFIG_* injection class
unsetting GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_* environment variables makes all five matrix parameter variants pass on the same dev host checkout

harness fix requires scrubbing GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_*/PARAMETERS from git helper functions and runner_env, and pinning GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null plus GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 to isolate subprocess git config scope
matrix test must be strengthened to deterministically inject the hostile git-config state in all environments (CI and dev hosts) to prove gh-independence regression coverage
